scope: Re-audit of the transcription runtime after a decode-parameter change. The checkpoint is unchanged; the adapter's decode behaviour is not.

machine.note: Shared development machine also running Story Studio, the GenStudio API and Postgres. Model inference was run strictly one at a time; wall-clock timings are therefore indicative of the ratio between arms, not of an idle-machine floor.

safety.note: Audio was read from the owner's project tree; no subtitle, script or project file was written. The comparison model checkpoint was fetched into a scratch cache outside the app's HF_HOME so the app's own model availability state was not altered.
